حببنا (form I)
# حَبَبْنَا (ḥababnā) /ħa.bab.naː/: first-person plural past active of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# حُبِبْنَا (ḥubibnā) /ħu.bib.naː/: first-person plural past passive of حَبَّ (ḥabba) and حُبَّ (ḥubba)
# حَبُبْنَا (ḥabubnā) /ħa.bub.naː/: first-person plural past active of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# حَبِبْنَا (ḥabibnā) /ħa.bib.naː/: first-person plural past active of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
